title: DatasetManifest
description: Standardized metadata schema for describing datasets in the VeriDoc AI platform.

version.description: Semantic versioning of the dataset format/content.

task.description: The primary ML task of the dataset (e.g. document_understanding, ocr, forgery_detection).

license.description: The licensing term under which this dataset can be used.

source.description: Reference source URL or citation for the dataset.
